faqs.title: Frequently asked questions
faqs.intro: Common questions about data visualization and analytics dashboards in OpenPanel.

items.question: What chart types does OpenPanel support?
items.answer: OpenPanel supports funnels, retention curves, conversion charts, Sankey diagrams, geographic maps, time series, and histograms. All chart types are available on every plan.

items.question: Do I need to write SQL to build charts?
items.answer: No. You build reports by selecting events, filters, and chart type from the UI. No SQL, no data pipelines-just pick your events and see results.

items.question: Can I share dashboards with my team?
items.answer: Yes. Dashboards are accessible to your team members. Pin charts, arrange them however you like, and everyone sees the same real-time data.

items.question: How often do charts update?
items.answer: Charts update in real time as new events arrive. There's no overnight processing or batch delay-data appears within seconds of being tracked.

items.question: What is a Sankey diagram?
items.answer: A Sankey diagram is a flow visualization that shows how users move through your product. Each path is drawn as a flow between steps, so you can see common journeys, unexpected branches, and exit points at a glance.

items.question: Can I use retention and funnel charts together?
items.answer: Yes. You can build funnels to find where users drop off and retention charts to see if the users who do convert come back. Combining both gives you a complete picture of activation and engagement.
